reason: I'd probably use the free visit, but $14 a trip on top of everything else is a lot on our budget when the library and the park are free. I'm not paying for a pack or membership until I've seen it works for us.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? A gated Baby Nook helps on paper, but I don't know how it feels with a 5-year-old next to it, and I don't want to pay $14 to hover over my toddler.
would_change_my_mind: Dedicated quiet hours for under-2s or a separate baby-only session, and a drop-in closer to $8-10 so it fits when I need a work-from-home morning.
